threat_event: A phished consultant account is used to read and copy client Part 37 security plans, implementing procedures, and approved-individual lists
threat_source: Cybercriminal or actor targeting category 2 licensees
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: "Clients" library readable by all 7 staff; copies synced to every laptop and kept in mailboxes; MFA push approval without number matching; no phishing training; no log review
existing_controls: MFA on the suite; laptops encrypted
treatment_plan: Restricted per-client folders open only to client-approved staff, with sync off; number matching for MFA; monthly review of access to the restricted folders; phishing training and quarterly exercises; encrypted delivery of client security information

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts laptops and the synced client library, and the lab records on the lab workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sync client carries encrypted files into the suite and then the backup; backup never restore-tested; antivirus alerts only in business hours; lab workstations unpatched
existing_controls: MSP patching and antivirus on laptops; firewall
treatment_plan: MSP-managed endpoint detection and response (EDR) with after-hours monitoring; 90-day immutable backup versions; quarterly restore tests; lab workstation plan (R-009)

threat_event: Malware on practice USB media is carried into a reactor plant during an outage and reaches plant digital assets (attempted pivot to client digital assets)
threat_source: Malware on a compromised practice laptop or personal media
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 personal USB drives in use; no scanning before site trips; no media inventory; malware already quarantined by a plant kiosk on 2026-04-14 and the laptop was never examined
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 (USB drives); BP-06; reactor client sites
regulatory_driver: C-NUCLEAR-S03 (reactor portable media terms; 4-hour notice); C-NUCLEAR-R01 (client's 73.54 program, by contract)
existing_controls: Plant kiosk scans all media at the gate; practice laptops never connected to plant networks
treatment_plan: Ban personal media from 2026-10-01; 6 company-issued encrypted USB drives, inventoried and scanned on a clean laptop before each trip; wipe after each outage; examine the laptop involved in the April event

threat_event: Staff who are not approved by a client (Office Manager, Project Coordinator) open that client's security information
threat_source: Workforce member (no malice; access by design)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All-staff library; Project Coordinator formats Part 37 reports; no list of client approvals; no written handling procedure
existing_controls: Clients approved 4 staff; approval letters on file for 4 of 6 clients
treatment_plan: Client approval list kept by the Part 37 services lead; restricted folders (R-001); Part 37 reports formatted only by approved staff; obtain the 2 missing approval letters

threat_event: A departed employee keeps system access and stays on clients' approved lists
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No departure checklist; SYS-02 account of the Health Physicist who left 2026-02-13 stayed active until 2026-08-04; the 2 clients that approved him were told only on 2026-08-05
existing_controls: Suite account disabled on the last day
treatment_plan: Departure checklist covering the suite, SYS-02, SYS-03, MFA, USB drives, keys, and client notices within 2 working days; monthly account reconciliation

threat_event: "Anyone with the link" sharing links expose client documents to unknown people
threat_source: Unintended recipient or anyone who obtains the link
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Link type allowed by default; 14 open links found, 2 to a client's Part 37 documents (shared with a client's contractor in 2025, never expired); log history only 180 days
existing_controls: None before 2026-08-05
treatment_plan: Remove all open links and disable the link type for the tenant (done 2026-08-05); client informed of the 2 Part 37 links on 2026-08-06

threat_event: Client security information is pasted into a public AI chatbot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list; a consultant pasted part of a client implementing procedure into a public chatbot in June 2026
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-04 4.6 approved-tools rule (no client information in public AI tools); training; client notified 2026-08-07 and its RSO documented the assessment

threat_event: Calibration readings or certificates are altered or lost, and a client relies on a wrong certificate
threat_source: Workforce error or attacker with SYS-02 access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 SYS-02 users without MFA; raw readings on an unencrypted lab workstation; no second check on certificates
existing_controls: SYS-02 audit trail; technician reviews each certificate
treatment_plan: MFA for all SYS-02 users (R-001 scope); quarterly audit-trail spot check of 10 certificates by the Principal Health Physicist

threat_event: Lab workstation 2 (gamma spectroscopy) is compromised or fails, stopping leak test analysis
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported operating system required by the spectroscopy software; excluded from patching; not backed up; rebuild depends on the software vendor
existing_controls: Behind the office firewall; no web browsing or email on it
treatment_plan: Move both lab workstations to a separate lab network segment with no internet access except the SYS-02 upload; image lab workstation 2 monthly; ask the software vendor for a supported version and budget the upgrade for 2027

threat_event: Suite mail and files cannot be restored after deletion, corruption, or encryption
threat_source: Backup misconfiguration or sync of damaged files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 30 days of versions; not immutable; never restore-tested; one shared MSP admin login
existing_controls: Nightly backup by the MSP
treatment_plan: First restore test; 90-day immutable versions; quarterly restore tests recorded; named MSP accounts

threat_event: Theft of an unencrypted lab workstation or loss of a USB drive exposes client information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lab workstations unencrypted; USB drives unencrypted and some personal; drives carry client survey data and report drafts
existing_controls: Suite alarmed after hours; calibration room locked
treatment_plan: Encrypt both lab workstations; company USB drives with hardware encryption (R-003)

threat_event: Photographed pages of a client's background investigation file (including a driver license copy) are disclosed
threat_source: Workforce member or attacker with library access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 photos taken during a 2025 access authorization program review sit in the all-staff library; no rule against copying background records
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Delete the photos and confirm deletion to the client in writing; rule in POL-04: never copy background investigation records, note sample IDs only

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool or shared admin logins gives attackers control of every computer, the firewall, and the backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agent with administrator rights on all 9 computers; shared MSP firewall login with no MFA; shared backup login; no review of MSP security; no incident notice terms
existing_controls: MSP states it uses MFA on its console (not evidenced)
treatment_plan: Named MSP accounts with MFA on the firewall and backup console; annual MSP security review with evidence; contract amendment with 24-hour incident notice and subcontractor list

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report an incident in time, so the 4-hour reactor and 24-hour Part 37 client notices are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan before P08; no reporting rule; the April 2026 kiosk event was handled by email with no record
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook; reporting card at every desk and in field kits; contact card with client security contacts; tabletop exercise

threat_event: SYS-02 vendor outage, business failure, or account lockout leaves the practice without its calibration and source records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Practice has never exported its records; single vendor
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 availability commitments (RTO 8 h, RPO 1 h)
treatment_plan: Monthly export of certificates, readings, and the source inventory to the suite

threat_event: The AI drift prediction module misses an instrument that will fail, or pooled training data exposes which clients hold category 2 sources
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot running since 2026-05-04 without an assessment; vendor terms allow pooled data; free-text location fields name client irradiator rooms
existing_controls: Recommendations are advisory; technician schedules recalls by hand
treatment_plan: Conditions in P10: no interval may be lengthened; scrub location fields; opt out of pooled training or get it in writing that data is de-identified; quarterly back-test

threat_event: Business email compromise leads to a fraudulent payment (fake vendor bank change or spoofed invoice)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No call-back rule for payment changes; no phishing training
existing_controls: MFA on the suite and accounting service
treatment_plan: Call-back rule for any bank detail change using a number on file; training (R-001)

threat_event: Hurricane closes the office and calibration laboratory for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; one site; source must stay secured
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from anywhere; laptops encrypted and portable
treatment_plan: Short contingency plan: laptops home before landfall, calibration source secured and checked after the storm, loaner meters shipped in advance, client notice script

threat_event: Attackers use a compromised practice mailbox to send malicious documents to clients, including Part 37 and reactor clients (attempted pivot into client networks)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clients trust practice mail; no mail alerts for new forwarding rules or mass sending; no number matching on MFA
existing_controls: Suite attachment scanning
treatment_plan: Suite alerts for new forwarding rules and unusual sending; number matching; client warning template in the P08 runbook

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop exposes client information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel to client sites and outages
existing_controls: All 7 laptops encrypted; MSP can wipe remotely
treatment_plan: Accepted: encrypted data is excluded from Florida's definition of personal information and protects client files; residual risk Low

threat_event: Internet outage at the office stops access to the SaaS systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line
existing_controls: Staff can work from mobile hotspots; lab readings can be recorded on paper
treatment_plan: Accepted: BP-03 tolerates 48 hours and work moves to hotspots; revisit if lab volume grows

threat_event: Older staff dose reports containing full Social Security numbers are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pre-2023 dosimetry reports with Social Security numbers kept in the "Admin" library with no reason to keep them
existing_controls: Library limited to staff with suite accounts
treatment_plan: Replace the old reports with redacted copies the processor provides; keep dose totals the license requires

threat_event: An attacker reaches lab workstation 2 through an inbound remote desktop port forward on the office firewall
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Port forward opened in 2024 for the spectroscopy vendor and never closed (found in P07 testing); unsupported operating system
existing_controls: Workstation password; no web browsing on it
treatment_plan: Rule removed 2026-08-25; vendor support only through MFA-protected, practice-approved sessions; quarterly firewall rule review
